warnings: 17 RC beam segments. Marks carry no level on this sheet (no BX(+X.XX) legend, unlike other siamplan sets) — no level_m is recorded. Every B1/B2/C1/GS/S1/ST tag was cross-checked against the PDF text layer positions (label beside a vertical beam = that beam, label just below a horizontal beam = that beam).

Two infill beams sit on no column: B1 on x = 1.90 (1''') from row A to A''' and B1 on y = 1.50 (A''') from grid 1 to grid 2 (S-01 chains 1.90 + 1.10 and 1.50 + 1.50). A'''1-A'''2 is kept as one segment and so are the grid-1 and grid-2 beams A-B: the 1''' / A''' beams land on them, they are not supports of them (section 5 splits only at supports).
Mark split: grids 1 and 2 between A and C and the whole of row A carry B2; grid 3, rows B, C, D and the porch legs C-D carry B1; the two infill beams are B1.

The ลานซักล้าง ground slab outside row A is drawn as a single outline (no beam on its outer edges) and its depth is not dimensioned on any sheet — recorded with a range ref and a note, no grid line invented (see grid master warnings).

Step marks on the plan are ST-01/ST-02 while the S-05 sections are titled ST-1/ST-2 — kept as printed on each sheet; each section names the beam it lands on (B2 / B1), matching the plan positions (row-A beam 1-2 is B2, row-D beam 1-2 is B1). Stair refs are approximate nearest points (section 10a).
